metadata_only_prefreeze_amendment: PREFREEZE_METADATA_AMENDMENT.json: reset on full raw acquisition timestamp gap>1second only; do not reset on nominal1Hz retained interval jitter
target_prior: Working jointGaussian mixture: zero-location prior atom mass2; prior VarU1/3, H=U1+E covariance with quality-scaled E. This matches a neutral bounded target second moment, not a uniformGaussian target density. Predictions truncate U to[-1,1].
information_controls: Exact source-target pair-product divides the product of each H_s,U density by target marginal power m-1; fullGaussian preserves all mean/covariance; factorized retains coordinate marginals; diagonal working-covariance intervention changes both prior-atom covariance and missing-source completion.
mandatory_reporting: All outcomes retained including ties/losses and admitted calibration/excess. CJ-R failed development is retained separately and is not the chosen physical method. No scientific repair after new held-out results.
